scope: Pinned sources for a general computational-chemistry knowledge layer covering basis-set retrieval and provenance, ORCA 6.1 basis semantics, xTB 6.7.1 method semantics, and an upstream agent-skill architecture reference.

operating_limits.native_input_authority: None of these sources authorizes a model to write or patch Gaussian, ORCA, or xTB native input. ChemSmart project loaders, command compilation, safe preview, and deterministic validation remain authoritative.
operating_limits.active_basis_catalog: The checked-in catalog generated with basis_set_exchange 0.11 is the active local harness authority. Upstream Basis Set Exchange 0.12 is a pinned research reference only and must not be used to claim active runtime coverage until a separately reviewed deterministic regeneration and validation milestone promotes it.
operating_limits.execution: No chemistry engine, upstream skill, installer, or scheduler was executed during this source audit.
operating_limits.licensed_text: No ORCA manual table, proprietary manual prose, or upstream skill prose is copied into ChemSmart. Only locators, identifiers, independently stated factual scope, and cryptographic/source metadata are recorded.
operating_limits.secrets: No credential or secret is required or recorded.
operating_limits.scientific_readiness: A source pin is provenance, not proof that a method, basis, solvent model, charge, multiplicity, or workflow is suitable for a particular molecular system.

sources.title: Basis Set Exchange: active local 0.11 snapshot and upstream 0.12 reference

license.scope_caveat: The root license covers the repository distribution. It does not replace basis-family and element-specific scholarly references or grant rights to the underlying publications.

access_limits: Install or dependency changes require separate authority; this audit did not install the package.
Do not regenerate the active catalog or substitute upstream 0.12 metadata for active runtime coverage in this task.
Promoting 0.12 requires a separate dependency-change milestone with deterministic catalog regeneration, focused drift review, and validation.
Every selected basis must retain its exact BSE basis version, element set, output format, response or package-data hash, and basis-specific references.
sources.evidence_ceiling: The checked-in 0.11 snapshot supports claims only about the recorded local catalog and its declared Gaussian/ORCA renderability checks. The pinned 0.12 release supports upstream release identity and future migration analysis only. Neither establishes scientific suitability, engine support for a selected molecule, numerical equivalence after conversion, or calculation correctness.

sources.title: Basis Set Exchange REST API

license.scope_caveat: Official API documentation identifies the project code as BSD-3-Clause. Returned basis data remains provenance-bearing scientific data and must retain basis-specific references.

access_limits: The service is mutable and is not a reproducible pin by itself.
A production lookup must record endpoint, normalized query, explicit basis version, response hash, retrieval time, and returned references.
Network failure or drift must block the lookup or fall back to the pinned package; it must not be filled from model memory.
sources.evidence_ceiling: A receipted response can establish what the service returned at one time. It cannot establish permanence, scientific appropriateness, or identity with a local engine's internal basis implementation.

license.per_file_caveat: The reviewed xTB skill frontmatter separately declares LGPL-3.0-or-later. Preserve per-file notices if reuse is ever authorized.

sources.rejection_rationale: Reviewed resources include direct Python execution, Gaussian native-input assembly, shell redirection, scratch deletion, and scheduler handoff patterns that bypass ChemSmart's typed compiler, artifact bindings, approvals, and evidence receipts.
access_limits: Do not install, invoke, vendor, or import the collection wholesale.
Do not copy prompts, examples, scripts, or prose into differently licensed ChemSmart content.
Future reuse must satisfy LGPL obligations and separate safety review.
A single implementer who reads and rewrites the source must not call the result clean-room; use independent, fact-based reimplementation wording.
sources.evidence_ceiling: Supports architecture comparison and identifies candidate concepts and unsafe surfaces at the pinned revision. It does not establish scientific correctness, ChemSmart compatibility, permission safety, or benchmark performance.
